decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1	It is considered that the proposed rear roof extension would, by reason of its size, appearance and position, detract from the existing appearance of the property and would harm the appearance of the rear street scene.  The proposed rear roof extension would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Section 8 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.  Furthermore, the three proposed roof lights on the front elevation would also be detrimental to the appearance of the street scene on Princes Avenue.  The proposed roof lights would be contrary to Section 8 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
2	The proposal would neither preserve nor enhance the character or appearance of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area.  The proposed rear roof extension would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and ENV-B.1.2 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and Section 7 in the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997) for Conservation Areas and does not comply with section 8 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of roof extension incorporating roof lights to front elevation to existing house (Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area).
